title: mechanic: pave package.patch, and fold test.live into git.repo.test --live
description:
## .what

two mechanic skills paved in a consumer repo, generic enough to own upstream:
1. `package.patch --package <name>@<version> --mode open|commit`: wrap `pnpm patch` / `pnpm patch-commit`, answer its interactive prompts under a pty (version pick + apply-to-all), and refuse when the edit dir is absent or already open
2. `test.live --live <gate>[,<gate>]`: run integration/acceptance suites with `TEST_LIVE` set to the named gates, so live cases run only when targeted and fail loud when targeted with no credential

## .why

prior art: `ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-nheuron` `.agent/repo=.this/role=any/skills/package.patch.sh` and `test.live.sh` (main). package.patch sits beside set.package.*; test.live is a `git.repo.test` flag in all but name.

## .ask

- package.patch beside set.package.install/upgrade
- fold test.live into `git.repo.test --live <gates>` rather than a peer skill
- note: package.patch cannot patch a package that ships read-only files (0555); see #1480
